description: Source code for device power management in Zephyr RTOS, including device state transitions, power domain management, and wakeup configurations.

methods.name: pm_device_state_str
methods.description: Converts device state enum to string representation.

methods.name: pm_device_action_run
methods.description: Executes a power management action on a device, updating its state accordingly.

methods.name: power_domain_add_or_remove
methods.description: Adds or removes a device from a power domain.

methods.name: pm_device_power_domain_remove
methods.description: Removes a device from its power domain.

methods.name: pm_device_power_domain_add
methods.description: Adds a device to a power domain.

methods.name: pm_device_state_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current power state of a device.

methods.name: pm_device_is_any_busy
methods.description: Checks if any device is currently busy.

methods.name: pm_device_is_busy
methods.description: Checks if a specific device is busy.

methods.name: pm_device_busy_clear
methods.description: Clears the busy status of a device.

methods.name: pm_device_wakeup_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables wakeup capability for a device.

methods.name: pm_device_wakeup_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if wakeup is enabled for a device.

methods.name: pm_device_wakeup_is_capable
methods.description: Checks if a device is capable of wakeup.

methods.name: pm_device_state_lock
methods.description: Locks the device state to prevent changes.

methods.name: pm_device_on_power_domain
methods.description: Checks if a device is part of a power domain.

methods.name: pm_device_is_powered
methods.description: Checks if a device is powered on.

methods.name: pm_device_driver_init
methods.description: Initializes device driver with power management actions.
